data.title: Arknights: Endfield PlayStation®5 Technical Test Access Distribution Now Underway
data.brief:
Dear Endministrator,
Access to Arknights: Endfield PlayStation®5 Technical Test is now being distributed. Use the methods below to check if you've been granted access.
data.data:
Dear Endministrator,

Access to Arknights: Endfield PlayStation®5 Technical Test is now being distributed. Use the methods below to check if you've been granted access.


▼// PlayStation®5 Technical Test Check Access Page

Go to the PlayStation®5 Technical Test Check Access page and log in using the Gryphline Account you used in the survey. Click [Check Now] to view your status.

Check link: https://endfield.gryphline.com/en-us/psCheckAccess


▼// Access Notice Email

Check the email you signed up with to see if you've received an access notice. Be sure to check your Spam or Promotions folder, as the message may have been filtered there.


▼// Important Notes

1. PlayStation®5 Technical Test is only open to adults. If you are a minor under the laws of your country or region, you are not eligible for test access. If the age you provide in the survey is found to be false, your test access will be revoked.

2. All content available for experience in PlayStation®5 Technical Test is from a work-in-progress build and does not represent the final look and quality of the game.

3. PlayStation®5 Technical Test access, accounts, and game clients must not be sold, shared, or transferred. Violations will result in your access being revoked. Also, do not change your linked account after access is granted, as this could cause your access to become invalid. Keep your personal account safe to avoid unnecessary losses.

4. PlayStation®5 Technical Test access is limited to this test only, and each Gryphline Account may receive access only once. Selected Endministrators will be granted test access on the PlayStation®5 console. Please use the PSN account you used to sign up for the PlayStation®5 Technical Test.

5. The test server will be closed and all data will be deleted after the test ends.


Thank you again for your continued interest and support for Arknights: Endfield, Endministrator!
